findings.location: Conclusion, pull quote and the first bolded attitude paragraph
findings.source_quote: “We can choose cynicism, blindness, pride, or humility” / “We can take the attitude of cynicism.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “mashaka ya kukatisha tamaa” with wording that conveys a cynical attitude, such as “mtazamo wa kijinsi” (and use the same term in the bolded heading and following paragraph).
findings.translation_quote: “Tunaweza kuchagua kuwa na mashaka ya kukatisha tamaa, kutofumbua macho, kiburi, au unyenyekevu” / “Tunaweza kuwa na mtazamo wa mashaka ya kukatisha tamaa.”

findings.location: Revivalism, definition quoted from Elwell Evangelical Dictionary
findings.source_quote: “a response of the whole being to the gospel’s call”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “mtu mzima” with “mtu kwa ujumla” or “nafsi nzima” to avoid reading “whole being” as “an adult.”
findings.translation_quote: “pale mtu mzima anapoitikia mwito wa injili”
